svg.text: Wiring the whole rig: UNO R4 WiFi, three IBT-2 bridges, motors with pots, motion sensor
The same pins as the original SMC3 on an UNO (MODE2, IBT-2 / BTS7960), so an existing rig needs no changes. Switch the motor power off and unplug USB while you wire.
pot wipers: motor 1 → A0, motor 2 → A1, motor 3 → A2 (add the pot noise filter here - Help, Pot noise filter)
Never put the sensor's wires straight on D0 / D1:
RS-232 levels damage the board. Detailed drawing:
Help, Motion sensor wiring. Optional - the rig runs
motor 1: IBT-2 control wires and pot wiper
motor leads, IBT-2 M+ / M− to the motor
GND: to the GND strip (the board's GND)
Wires that cross without a dot aren't connected.
A motor goes the wrong way? The full check in
Diagnostics says so: swap that motor's M+ and M−.
Pot GND straight to the board's GND strip -
not to the IBT-2 or the motor supply.
Keep pot cables away from motor cables.
5V and GND (keep them as they are)
